billing.billing.request: Nested copy of the billing envelope for clients that prefer grouped metadata.
billing.billing_mode: Access mode used by the request.
billing.cost_usd: Canonical actual charged cost. For grant, API-key, internal, or discovery paths this is 0.
billing.credits_charged: Integer credit equivalent charged for this response. One credit equals one cent.
billing.grant_budget_usd: Total promotional budget allocated to the grant when present.
billing.grant_cache_treatment: How cached versus fresh reads affect promotional budget.
billing.grant_credit_equivalent_limit: Compatibility cents-equivalent budget view retained in the grant session mint response.
billing.grant_credit_equivalent_remaining: Compatibility cents-equivalent remaining-budget view retained in the grant session mint response.
billing.grant_debit_policy: Policy used to decrement promotional budget.
billing.grant_debit_usd: Promotional budget consumed by the covered request.
billing.grant_expires_at: Budget-grant expiry timestamp, distinct from challenge or session token expiry.
billing.grant_expires_in_seconds: Seconds until budget-grant expiry, clamped to zero once expired.
billing.grant_id: Stable promotional grant identifier when present.
billing.grant_limit_type: Unit family for the current grant contract surface.
billing.grant_limit_unit: Concrete unit for grant_limit or grant runway reporting.
billing.grant_program: Grant program that covered the request.
billing.grant_remaining_usd: Promotional budget remaining after the covered request.
billing.grant_runway_authoritative_fields: Fields clients should use as the authoritative runway for promotional grants.
billing.grant_status: Grant state resolved for the request.
billing.quoted_cost_usd: Public x402 equivalent quote for the route.
billing.settlement_receipt: Per-call settlement and grant receipt. This is the authoritative call-level attribution surface when wallet deltas are unavailable or batched.
billing.settlement_receipt.charge_status: Call-level settlement state: not_charged, authorized, queued_for_batch, submitted, settled, failed, refunded, or disputed.
billing.settlement_receipt.reconciliation_key: Stable key for accounting exports and support reconciliation.
billing.settlement_receipt.settlement_mode: Access and settlement rail used by this call: api_key_not_charged, grant_covered, x402_direct, mpp, circle_gateway_batched, or shadow_unsettled.
billing.usage_metadata: Legacy performance/cost estimate block; not authoritative for settled public spend.

grant_auth.message_template:
DeltaSignal wallet grant
wallet: <lowercase_wallet>
method: <HTTP_METHOD>
path: <URL_PATH>
host: <request_host>
timestamp: <RFC3339_OR_UNIX_SECONDS>
grant_auth.note: For AgentCash/x402 clients, call the challenge/session endpoints before settlement and attach the returned grant token. Plain unsigned wallet headers remain rejected.
